label: kizuna_math_d_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Help me keep an eye\nout,\r\nwould you?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_02
text: I’ve set up a little ambush here for that girl who\nkeeps watching me! She’ll be here any second![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_select_01
text: An ambush?!

label: kizuna_math_d_select_02
text: Why?!

label: kizuna_math_d_03
text: Well, you see, it’s not very pleasant knowing\nshe’s just staring at me all the time.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_04
text: And now I know what she looks like after seeing\nher in the cafeteria![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_06
text: It’s you, isn’t it?! You’re the one who’s been\nsecretly watching me recently![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_01
text: T-Tyme?! How’d you know I—

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_02
text: I guess you must have noticed me... I-I’m so sorry!

label: kizuna_math_d_07
text: Well, of course I noticed—you were watching me\npractically all day every day, after all!\c\nI assume there’s something you want to ask me?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_03
text: Y-yes...I do.

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_04
text: I’ve been a huge fan of yours since your time as\na Gym Leader! And I love Rock-type moves so\r\nvery much!

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_05
text: But you just suddenly retired from your post as\nGym Leader a year and a half ago...\c\nWhy did you quit?!

label: kizuna_math_d_09
text: My goodness... Is that all you wanted to ask?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_06
text: Yes. Your reason for retiring was never\nmade public...

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_07
text: but it’s well known among the students here that\nyou just avoid the question any time it’s asked.

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_08
text: I thought it would be rude to ask you a question\nthat you don’t want to answer...so I just couldn’t\r\nfind the courage to ask.

label: kizuna_math_d_10
text: So that’s why your gaze felt so very intense. I see.\nForgive me.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_09
text: So very...intense?

label: kizuna_math_d_11
text: Ah, never mind that. As for the reason I quit my\njob as Gym Leader, I simply wanted to focus\r\nmore on my job as a teacher.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_12
text: It’s not that I disliked being a Gym Leader or\nanything of that sort.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_13
text: Quite the contrary—talking about the Gym fills\nme with feelings of nostalgia and sadness.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_14
text: That’s why I always avoid answering the question\nwhen students ask.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_10
text: Oh. I see...

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_11
text: Do you have any plans of becoming a Gym\nLeader again?

label: kizuna_math_d_15
text: No, I’m afraid I don’t plan to do so.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_16
text: My sister is doing a splendid job as Gym Leader\nin my stead.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_17
text: I personally find being a teacher most enjoyable\nthese days.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_18
text: But since I am, in fact, your teacher...I would\nappreciate it if you would call me “Ms. Tyme,”\r\nas students do, and not just “Tyme.”[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_12
text: OK. I’m sad to hear that, but I understand!

label: kizuna_math_d_woman_13
text: Thank you so much, Ms. Tyme!

label: kizuna_math_d_19
text: Well, I suppose that solves the mystery![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_20
text: Ahhh, that made me so nervous! I said so many\nthings to try to sound cool![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_21
text: I was certainly a little scared when I felt that girl’s\nintense gaze on me.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_22
text: But having you here with me allowed me to do\nwhat needed to be done to face what turned out\r\nto be one of my biggest fans.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_23
text: I must thank you for always showing up at just the\nright time, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_24
text: Allow me to show you my appreciation a little.\nI hope these help on your adventure.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_d_system_01
text: You formed a close bond with Ms. Tyme!
